Very different game to what I have played before and there are even different styles you can play as!
You can play as stealthy and get your goal(s) done without being noticed, or stealth killing every baddy you see
You can play as a juggernaut as I like to call it, and rush in big and loud, blowing crap up and making a huge ruckus
You can also even play as a healer now! Making sure your allies stay alive and assist them in taking down your enemies

-Awesome graphics
-Quite a few controls, but I actually found it pretty easy to get used to it
-Different moves to avoid attacks and counter attack with, from spinning with your swords, sliding around a corner and shooting your target in the face or even just dropping down on your target to kill them
-Quite a few different weapons to choose from! You can have quite the arsenal if you want to, especially if you decide to spend some cash
-Like most games like this, there are always the person who buys premium with their own money to get ahead, but at least you are not forced to deal with them! Plus almost everything you can farm the materials for! It just takes time! Plus if you practice and earn the items, you will most likely be better than the dude that just started and dropped like 30 bucks for the same exact stuff
-In PVP the names are visible btw, so going stealthy isnt the way to go! :/ but it is fun to try anyways!

10/10 Wonderful graphics and gameplay! Very fun indeed!

Edit: I have played a few extra hours. The game is still quite enjoyable and the changes made to the game and the new warframes they added since then have made it even better.

Shares a lot of concepts with Destiny (althought it DID come before Destiny!), and it's a much less polished game.
What it lacks in polish, though, it makes up for in sheer ambition and content.
This game has a lot more to offer than Destiny.
